why_the_port_is_feasible: struct nsproxy keeps the ipc_ns and pid_ns_for_children fields and its layout is config independent, so module-owned namespace objects can be published there
no compiled kernel code dereferences nsproxy->ipc_ns while CONFIG_IPC_NS is off, so the IPC namespace can be a module-owned struct whose lifetime the module controls
the IPC syscalls exist only as weak aliases to __arm64_sys_ni_syscall, and sys_call_table is reachable, so the module can install its own handlers
BTF exposes the exact 6.1 layouts of ipc_namespace, pid_namespace, pid and upid for an offline ABI comparison against the DDK build

cfi_implementation.conclusion: KCFI, i.e. the flavour src/port61/hooks.c already matches; the 5.15 port needs classic .cfi_jt and would not fit this kernel
